definitions.gloss: winning ticket; winning lot (in a lottery or draw)
definitions.explanation: A lottery ticket, raffle ticket or drawn lot that wins a prize. The opposite is はずれくじ, a losing ticket. Also used figuratively for a lucky choice that turned out well.

examples.japanese: {当|あ}たりくじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
{当|あ}たりくじ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十本|じっぽん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧だ。
examples.english: One in ten lots is a winner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{福引|ふくび}き→福引き：17826_fukubiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{当|あ}たりくじ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I drew a winner in the shopping street's prize draw and got a bicycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当|あ}たりくじだった⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Picking this restaurant was a lucky draw. The food is really good.

notes:
Made of ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (a hit, a win) + くじ (lot, lottery ticket). The opposite is はずれくじ (a losing ticket), and the plain nouns ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ and はずれ are used the same way: ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧, はずれだった.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当|あ}たりくじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a winning lot
- {当|あ}たりくじ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a winning ticket comes up
- ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当|あ}たりくじ: a winning lottery ticket
- {当|あ}たりくじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{当|あ}てる: to hit on a winner (also figurative)

USAGE:
Figuratively, {当|あ}たりくじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ means to make a lucky choice, such as a good roommate or a good teacher; はずれくじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ is the unlucky counterpart.
